definitions.h: max k in [0,N] with at least k works having c_i>=k
definitions.g: max k in [0,N] with sum of top k counts >= k^2; no fictitious extra zero-citation works
definitions.known_total: sum of observed counts accumulated with checked u128 and serialized as decimal text

missingness: reject, or monotone extremal completions: zero lower; u64::MAX upper for each unknown count. Upper construction valid for index thresholds under N<=100000. No unknown-work or erroneous-count guarantee.
empty_population: complete summary with all indices and total zero; no coverage fraction is asserted
canonicalization: RFC8785 via serde_json_canonicalizer; counts are decimal strings; observations are sorted by unchanged identifier before hashing
denominator: N supplied, uniquely identified actual publications in the named population; counts refer to the explicitly named citation universe and cutoff

comparators.name: bibliometrix Hindex
comparators.requirements: pin package, corpus, author-resolution and actual-N g convention; record divergences rather than forcing equality

comparators.name: PyBibX
comparators.requirements: confirm method support and input conventions before comparison

claim_boundary: Conventional methods; no new metric, scientific quality ranking, global author completeness, external parity or beyond-frontier claim.
